lines: Even the rainbow after the rain
And the flower that bloomed proudly
To you who gaze at the crimson sky
That day I fell in love
Even a single frame in the film
It will not fade from my heart
No matter how bright a star
Even the headache brought by low pressure
Is forgotten when I meet you
Your voice circulates through my whole body
I won't let go any more
To the sky filled with wishes
I was drawn in and started running too
Unknowingly we began to cross paths
No matter how bright a star
The answer is always coincidence? destiny?
The path we once chose will become fate
Both the hope and the anxiety we clutched
Will surely become the light that moves us both
